explanation_short: Ethanol, Acetate, and Butyrate exhibit the highest mean values, while Ethanol also shows the largest standard deviation among the measured features.
explanation_full: Based on the descriptive statistics, Ethanol (mean: 0.4736, std: 0.2528), Acetate (mean: 0.4465, std: 0.226), and Butyrate (mean: 0.4287, std: 0.2474) have the highest mean values among the measured features. Propionate (mean: 0.3675, std: 0.2158) and VSS (mean: 0.3581, std: 0.1538) follow. Furthermore, Ethanol has the largest standard deviation (0.2528), followed by Butyrate (0.2474) and Acetate (0.226).
